notes: Lean (Mathlib): A083125_pal81 (decimal palindrome P with 81 | P has 81 | digit sum; 2P = S(9n-7) mod 81 from 10^i = 1+9i mod 81), A083125_pal81_large (then P >= 10^8). Consequence: 81 enters right after the first term a with 81a palindromic, which needs a = 12345679 or a >= 123456791; all multiples of 81 are delayed the same way. Computation: 81 still missing after 180000 terms; after 60000 terms the missing values below 2000 are the 22 non-multiples of 10 among 81*{1..24} and 1465; largest of the first 60000 terms 119094117. Outside Lean: the step from the lemma to the sequence (definition plus the first 2000 terms) and the computations (seq.c).

prior_art.note: The mod-81 palindrome lemma is elementary; not stated in the entry. Conjecture open.
